claims.claim: OpenAI added real-time collaboration to ChatGPT Slides allowing multiple users to edit the same deck simultaneously.
claims.episode_span: OpenAI added live collaboration to ChatGPT Slides so multiple people can work on the same presentation at once.
claims.source_title: OpenAI adds real-time collaboration to ChatGPT Slides, introduces other new features
claims.supporting_quote: OpenAI has announced new features for ChatGPT Slides, including real-time collaboration, allowing multiple people to work on the same deck and share feedback.

claims.claim: Kling AI version 4.0 supports clips up to 30 seconds with stereo audio and multilingual lip sync.
claims.episode_span: The video tool Kling just released version 4.0 that can now create 30-second clips with stereo sound and lip-sync in multiple languages.
claims.source_title: Kling AI drops version 4.0 with stereo audio, multilingual lip sync, and a lighter Flash variant
claims.supporting_quote: Kling AI has released version 4.0 of its video generator with support for clips up to 30 seconds, ten keyframe images as input, and prompt comprehension expanded to 8,000 tokens.
